bullets.text: Dunk spotted a mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and told the party he had a plan to get it.
Dr. Uriah and Trout caught Naggeneen, a Clurichen, and Quinn hung him in a bag behind his bar.
Dunk proposed that Ingrid brew a sleeping potion for Warwick.
Father William told the party he had sent Brother Dirk to Brandon's Barrow Mound for a dragon-slaying sword.
Father William marked the Barrow Mound and the witch's home on the party's map.
Dr. Uriah agreed to repay Father William for the map markings with penance and a donation.
George, a one-armed survivor, told the party the dragon's lair lies at the foot of the northern mountains.
Trout recruited the halfling Squints as a junior member of his Halfling Corps.
Dunk out-drank the fauns and traded a rabbit's foot for a flask of faun wine.
Ingrid told Uriah that fairies who once stayed hidden have been coming out more often.
Squints pulled a bound Brother Dirk from a sack in a giant's cottage, and the party outran the woken giant.
Sir Phidipaldi objected when Brother Dirk said he should go home, and Trout assigned Dirk to Squints.

bullets.detail: Its body must be dragged into town to collect. It is uncertain whether Eric has the gold.
bullets.text: Kill the black dragon and collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Find the treasure shown on the party's map.

bullets.detail: His friends' arrows and swords all failed.
bullets.text: George says nothing pierces the dragon's black scales.

bullets.detail: The diluted faun wine and Ingrid's uncertain skill may weaken the potion.
bullets.text: If Dunk helps Ingrid give Warwick her sleeping potion tonight, Warwick may sleep while Dunk is inside with the mithril shirt.

bullets.detail: George says no one knows if the legend is true or where the sword is.
bullets.text: Father William says that if the party retrieves the sword buried with Sir Brandon, they can slay the dragon.

bullets.detail: Lady Hilda is a seasoned fighter.
bullets.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, she will join their dragon hunt.

bullets.detail: His fee is 100 gold a week. He insists on getting to kill people.
bullets.text: If the party pays Drop Dead Ned, he and his killer wasp will work for them.
If Dunk gets Warwick's mithril chain shirt, it could protect against the dragon.
Where are the map's marked locations, and which one holds the treasure?
Why has nothing reached Brandonsford in months, including Bentley's overdue shipment?
Where did this new dragon come from, centuries after Sir Brandon's?
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house to give him the sleeping potion once she brews it.
Dr. Uriah must do penance for Father William at Brandon's Barrow Mound.

bullets.detail: The donation is for the Barrow Mound's upkeep.
bullets.text: Dr. Uriah must donate 10 gold to Father William.

bullets.detail: It is second pick, after the elite members.
bullets.text: Trout's Halfling Corps owes Squints a pick of the first treasure if he funds himself and follows orders.

bullets.detail: Gill's three sons are hunting it now.
bullets.text: The black dragon killed George's friends and took his arm. George says it will soon fly, dooming the town.
